engine: Editorial word timing (faster-whisper small.en CPU) for karaoke captions / icon pops
symptom: Builder QA reported first-word start delta 0.000 s and last-word end delta 0.000 s against the RMS speech onset/offset on all 14 shots — a perfect score that proves nothing.
root_cause: The builder calibrated the first/last word edges TO the RMS onset/offset and then measured the same edges against the same RMS values, so the gate sits exactly where the two quantities coincide (always green). Raw Whisper starts can differ: S02_A 'Good' raw 0.68 s vs calibrated 0.07 s.
fix_or_workaround: Root re-ran faster-whisper independently on S01_A, S02_A, S04_B, S06_B: interior word starts agree within <=0.2 s (mostly 0.02-0.1 s); only calibrated edges move (up to 0.61 s). Accepted for karaoke; icon pops use the raw Whisper start when it differs >0.3 s from the calibrated start.
prevention: A QA gate must compare quantities that can disagree: compare the raw ASR timestamps (before any calibration) with the RMS measurements, keep raw and calibrated fields separate, and have root/critic re-run the recogniser on at least 3 shots. A gate that has never been red is unproven (cach-lam-viec §3d).
verification: Root rerun table in session 2026-10-27; PLAN row T-V12b.
